title: Calculate Command Term IB: What It Really Means
summary: Calculate command term IB: learn what examiners expect, how to show working, avoid lost marks, and build stronger answers across DP subjects in exams.
body_markdown:
The **calculate command term IB** definition is simple: obtain a numerical answer while showing the relevant stages of your working. Write enough mathematics for an examiner to identify your method, follow your substitutions, and understand your final value.


A calculator display alone rarely provides a complete response. Include the relationship used, essential intermediate steps, and a clearly presented result, with units and appropriate precision where required.


The distinction matters: your answer needs to communicate how you reached the number.


### The calculate command term IB checklist


When you see **calculate** , check these five elements:


- Identify the required quantity.
- Write the appropriate relationship or method.
- Substitute the relevant values clearly.
- Show the essential stages of working.
- State the answer with suitable units and precision.


The amount of working should match the task. A simple arithmetic question may need one line; a multi-stage problem needs more. Show the stages relevant to the available marks.


Keep the[complete IB exam command terms guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/ib-exam-command-terms-list) nearby while practising.

### What counts as relevant working?


Relevant working is the shortest clear route demonstrating a valid method. Avoid recording every button pressed or listing disconnected formulas.

The formula, substitution, evaluated result, and unit are visible. Follow any stated accuracy requirement; otherwise, use precision consistent with subject expectations. Keep extra digits during intermediate calculations to avoid unnecessary rounding errors.


Check units before substituting values. A speed in kilometres per hour cannot be combined directly with a time in seconds unless you convert one of them first. Write the conversion alongside your working so you can trace any mistake. Then ask whether the answer is plausible. A calculated walking speed of several hundred metres per second should prompt another look at your inputs.


IB Mathematics markschemes distinguish method marks from answer or accuracy marks. An arithmetic slip after a valid setup may therefore leave evidence that can earn credit, depending on the question.

### How calculate differs from similar command terms


Read the exact instruction because similar verbs require different responses.


Command term Expected response


Calculate Produce a numerical answer with relevant working.


Determine Obtain the only possible answer from the available information.


Estimate Find an approximate value.


Show Present the stages establishing a given result.


Solve Obtain an answer through algebraic or numerical methods.


Explain Give reasons or mechanisms.


For **calculate** , you usually find the destination yourself. For **show** , a result may already be supplied, and your working must establish it.


Combined instructions require combined responses. “Calculate the rate and explain the difference” needs both arithmetic and a reasoned explanation.


### How calculation responses earn marks


There is no universal mark allocation for calculate questions. Credit depends on the subject, assessment, and specific markscheme.


Mathematics may reward method separately from accuracy. Some science markschemes allow error carried forward, meaning later reasoning can receive consideration when an earlier incorrect result is used consistently. Neither provision guarantees credit for every written step.


If an early result looks suspicious, check it when possible and continue logically. Clear substitutions, intermediate values, units, and symbols give the examiner evidence to assess throughout your response.


### Check the answer before moving on


Use a brief final check to catch errors that extra working alone may miss. Have you calculated the quantity requested, or stopped at an intermediate value? If the question asks for concentration, finding the amount of substance is only part of the route. Read the final sentence again and compare it with your answer.


Check calculator entries involving brackets, powers, and negative signs. When dividing by a product, make the denominator explicit. If time allows, estimate the answer independently using rounded values. The estimate will not replace your calculation, but it can reveal a misplaced decimal point or an incorrect power of ten.


### Build a reliable practice routine


Choose calculation questions using the[RevisionDojo Questionbank practice guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/revisiondojo-question-bank-review-quality-accuracy) . Before using your calculator, identify the requested quantity and write the relevant relationship.


Compare your response with the solution or marking guidance. Record whether mistakes came from formula selection, rearrangement, substitution, arithmetic, units, or rounding. That distinction makes your next practice session more focused.

Lina’s first answer had the correct number. Her final answer showed why it was correct. Build that habit through targeted practice, and make every calculation communicate its reasoning.
